provenance.construction: Start with three [[4,2,2]] plaquette codes on adjacent 2x2 squares. Retain each inner block's X^4 and Z^4 stabilizers. Add two X-type stabilizers, each the product of the weight-2 logical X representative X0X1 on neighboring blocks (supports [0,1,4,5] and [4,5,8,9]); this connects all three blocks and is not a direct sum.
provenance.notes: The [[12,4,2]] parameters exist in other weight-6 entries; this is a distinct weight-4 local realization. See notes/12-4-2-c.md.

circuit.notes: Johnson-coil + 4 span flags sequential extraction (max_flags=2 per check, 5 X + 4 Z edge-colored data CX layers per round, coloring candidate 0); generated by qldpc submit (research/circuit_autogen.py, seed 0), the first of up to 6 candidates whose RIS screen at 2 rounds found nothing below d; witnesses from RIS on ker(H_dem) at twice the gate's trial budget, validated in GF(2)
